cases.why: The one read route on this service, declared inline in main.ts with NO withAuth wrapper — which is why every survey that walked services/*/src/adapters/http/** missed it.
A PUBLIC key endpoint. The signing private key lives only in scheduling-service's config.
The controller hardcodes the literal 'Ed25519'. And note this is a DIFFERENT key from the token issuer's — verifying a bearer token with it will fail.
